*.rationale: Modifies files in place with -i flag; changes are bounded to specified files, expected, and reversible.

note: Deliberately kept unreviewed -- do NOT mark reviewed. Re-reviewing regenerates a blanket Bash(sed:*) ask rule on the next apply, which shadows the hand-maintained Bash(sed -n *) allow rule (ask beats allow, no specificity tiebreak). See contributing/cli-allowlist.md's 'sed -- deliberately unreviewed' section.
